vetSays.line: 🛡️ Caleb, Jamie, Sam and Taisia met them at the door — 4 put down. Caleb, Jamie, Taisia are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.

The Elder Big-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Big-Eyes!
📺 You brought down Elder Big-Eyes. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Caleb, Jamie, Jithin and Greta met them at the door — 4 put down. Caleb, Jamie, Jithin, Greta are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Wanjiru taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Wanjiru drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Caleb strikes the Elder The Moderator.
The Elder The Moderator falls.
📺 Caleb brought down Elder The Moderator. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Caleb brought down Elder The Moderator. Together.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jamie just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sam just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jamie, Sam, Jithin, Wanjiru and Sigrun met them at the door — 5 put down. Sam, Jithin, Wanjiru, Sigrun are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Scott just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Everton, Scott and Maria met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Everton didn't come back. Scott, Maria are hurt.

"What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here?"

"Can we talk?" Jamie glances around first. "People are saying things. About you. Is any of it true?"
Somchai: "You. Yeah, you. What do you make of this?"
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"Can I tell you something? I'm practicing what I would say if I ever saw my family again. I haven't told anyone."
"About the pantry run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
Caleb: "I've heard good things about Thornfield. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"The pantry run — I haven't stopped thinking about it."
"Have you ever hurt someone? Since all this started."
"About whether you've hurt someone — Have you ever hurt someone? Since all this started."
"What got you through the first week? The very first days."
If there's a job nobody wants, I'll take it. That's how you earn a place, right?
"Where are you from — originally? Before all this."
"Can I tell you something? I've been hiding an injury. I'm ashamed and I can't stop."
"About what got you through the first week — What got you through the first week? The very first days."
"Real talk — Okay, so — something happened this morning."
"Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"Listen. I need you to hear this before you go back out there."
"Has this changed you? Like, fundamentally?"
"Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone?"
"About what happened to my taken kin — I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one. ...sorry, lost it."
"About how this changed you — Has this changed you? Like, fundamentally?"
"Can I tell you something? I have been lying about my age — I'm younger than I look."
"Can we talk? Have you seen anyone on the roads? Anyone at all? I'm asking everyone."
"Can I tell you something? I'm saving a candy bar for when things get better. I haven't told anyone."
"I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one."
"About what happened to my taken kin — You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Ivan?"
"We're down to 3 liters of clean water. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"Never mind the creek water run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"About what happened to my taken kin — Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"Please — have you got anything to spare? Anything? My hands shake when I try to work."
"What do you miss most? From before."
"When's the last time you really laughed?"
"The cistern's nearly dry — 7 liters left. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"
"Can I tell you something? At night I talk to someone who isn't there anymore."
"Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing."
"Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
"About who you don't trust — Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
"Can I tell you something? Before the scattering, I froze when it mattered. I think about it every day."
"Any regrets? The real kind, not the small stuff."
"About your regrets — Any regrets? The real kind, not the small stuff."
"Can I be honest? Listen. I need you to hear this before you go back out there."
"Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that."
I keep their faces in my head like photographs. If I stop looking, I might lose them.

"Hey. Got a minute? No reason. Just — hey."
"I can't reach this properly. Could you take a look?"

"I asked Caleb about the kindest thing someone's done for you — Caleb's gone. What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"Mm. Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them."
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"

"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"Look. Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them."

lines.line: (Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
